item.title: Awesome Indie Adventures
item.content:encoded:
Looking for your next big adventure? Our newest bundle has our favorite indie games full of dynamic characters and exciting storylines for everyone ready to dive into a great story. Wield your bow and lift the curse on a mysterious island in The Pathless! Solve the puzzles to escape the Gloom in the retro survival horror game Post Trauma! Become the monsters you kill and rebuild a fallen civilization in Biomorph! There’s even more adventure to discover in this bundle, so grab these great games now at the price of your choosing and support music charity Reverb with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 28th, 2027.

item.title: Short Games Showcase Bundle
item.description: A showcase of short, great games
item.content:encoded:
Don’t let life keep you from unwinding with a great game—cozy up for a quick session with our Short Games Showcase. Play Botany Manor, the cozy garden sim where you experiment with flora and fauna as a botanist. Try Anomaly Agent, the bloody good retro-inspired side-scrolling beat ’em up armed with an addictive synthwave soundtrack! Or connect with a friend for a co-op moment in Biped, the speed-and movement-focused puzzler. Pay what you want for 14 games that work around your schedule and help support Comic Relief with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 28th, 2027.

item.title: In Your World VR Bundle
item.description: Lose yourself in the magic of VR
item.content:encoded:
Level up your VR collection with an epic bundle of titles perfect for all VR hardware. Kick demonic ass as the Doom Slayer in DOOM VFR, the ultimate tour through the depths of hell! Explore Into the Radius, a single-player survival shooter where you explore a surreal world filled with dangerous anomalies. Or brave Labyrinthine, an entirely unique co-op horror experience where 1-8 players must survive procedurally generated maps! Try new VR experiences and help support the International Medical Corps with your purchase.

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 26th, 2027.

item.title: No More Robots: The Unhinged Indie Anthology
item.content:encoded:
Looking to expand your library of indie games? Look not further than this bundle in collaboration with publisher No More Robots, full of games of every genre for any type of player! Design your perfect wildlife wonderland and breed never-before-seen creatures in Let’s Build a Zoo! Manage your kingdom and please your petitioners in medieval strategy RPG Yes, Your Grace! Clean up the streets of cyberspace in the ’90s internet simulator Hypnospace Outlaw! There’s even more to enjoy in this fantastic indie bundle, so grab it now at the price of your choice and support Special Effect charity with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 26th, 2027.

item.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Classics Collection 2026
item.description: All the classics you know and love
item.content:encoded:
Beloved tabletop adventure game Dungeons & Dragons goes digital in this bundle of classic D&D video games! This massive collection includes classic favorites and deep cuts with that vintage video game vibe for hours of pixelated dungeon fun. See where it all started in all three collections of Forgotten Realms: The Archives, including standards like the Eye of the Beholder trilogy and Curse of the Azure Bonds! Gather allies and defeat the Dark Queen in the Krynn series, survive the savage world of the Dark Sun, outsmart Count Strahd of Ravenloft, and more! There are countless adventures to be had in this collection of D&D classics, so grab them now at the price of your choosing and support the American Humane Society with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 21st, 2027.

item.title: Rage Inducing Difficult Games
item.description: Rage quitting is for the weak
item.content:encoded:
If the game isn’t challenging, then does it even count? Pay what you want for the Rage Inducing Difficult Games Bundle, where every title is a battlefield! Test your skills in GRIME, the unforgiving action-adventure RPG centered around horror and intrigue. Take on Lorn’s Lure, the perilous platformer with novel climb-anything mechanics. Or turn up the platforming heat with Jump King, where one missed jump could ruin your run! Discover your limits and help support Prevent Cancer in the process.

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 19th, 2027.

item.title: Idlers and Desktop Companions
item.content:encoded:
There are few things more boring than sitting at a desk all day and watching the minutes tick by—that’s why we’ve made this bundle of games for anyone who needs a little office hours momentum! These idle games and desktop companions are built to fill time and provide some much needed motivation whenever you feel stuck in a rut. Gamify your tasks with Spirit City: Lofi Sessions, a focus tool that allows you to build your perfect cozy space! Turn your desktop screen into a lush homestead in farming simulator Rusty’s Retirement, an island paradise in Ropuka’s Idle Island, or a thrilling battlefield with Desktop Defender! There are even more ways to make your workday a little more exciting, so grab these games now at the price of your choice, and support suicide prevention charity CALM with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 14th, 2027.

item.title: Animal Style Bundle
item.description: Take a bite out of boredom
item.content:encoded:
Calling all animal lovers—we’ve assembled the perfect mix of cozy and captivating games for you! Befriend and summon over 1,000 unique creatures in the epic dungeon-crawler Siralim Ultimate, manage a cute community of cozy dinosaurs in Amber Isle, beat up bad guys in the grim world of BROK the InvestiGator, where anthropomorphic animals have replaced mankind, and more. Pay what you want to punch your ticket into the animal kingdom of gaming and help support Trees, Water & People with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 14th, 2027.

item.title: Point Click Package
item.content:encoded:
Unlock retro vibes galore with the Point & Click Package Bundle! Experience Syberia - Remastered, the fully updated adventure of protagonists Kate and Oscar. The rich world of this first entry mixes point-and-click gameplay with immersive visuals and gripping storytelling for a whole new generation. Or try Amerzone - The Explorer's Legacy - Digital Deluxe Upgrade, a mysterious quest for the Great White Birds in a land full of secrets to uncover! Rediscover one of the truly great genres of early gaming and help support Xperience Studios with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 12th, 2027.

item.title: Twin Sails Interactive 2026
item.description: A new spin on the board games you love
item.content:encoded:
Love board games but don’t love keeping track of all those pesky pieces? We have the solution: all the games you love in digital form, to play on your console or PC! We’ve teamed up with Twin Sails Interactive for a massive digital bundle of board games and add-ons, from classic fantasy tales, sci-fi adventures, horror stories, and beyond. Scheme your way to the Iron Throne in A Game of Thrones: The Board Game! Enter the mysterious, eldritch world of H.P. Lovecraft in Arkham Horror: Mother’s Embrace! Gather resources and conquer the Red Planet in Terraforming Mars! Lead a band of mercenaries through the dangerous lands of Gloomhaven! There’s a lot more to explore in this bundle of fan-favorite digital board games and expansion packs, so grab them now at the price of your choice, and support the gene therapy outreach of FOXG1 Research Foundation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before August 12th, 2027.

item.title: Even Steamier Sakura Special
item.content:encoded:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Add some spice to your summer with the 2026 Even Steamier Sakura Bundle of titillating titles! Are you ready for Mei-Mei? Your favorite bunny girls are back and more voluptuous than ever with Sakura Bunny Girls 1 & 2, the romantic visual novel games where you, an average Joe, encounter gorgeous supergirls! Or find love within the Sakura Isekai Adventure series, a set of yuri adventures that mixes real-life situations with cat-eared cuties! Turn up the heat and the fun with this epic collection by Winged Cloud, and help support Direct Relief with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 7th, 2027.

item.title: 2K Megahits 2026 Bundle
item.content:encoded:
If your gaming library needs a summer refresh, look no further than this bundle of publisher 2K’s greatest hits!! Here you’ll find monster battling games, steampunk adventures, mobster action, and everything in between. Survive a hostile alien planet full of vicious beasts and plenty of loot in Risk of Rain 2! Work your way up the crime family ladder and become mobster royalty without getting whacked in Mafia II: Definitive Edition! Save a woman from a flying city and discover the secrets of BioShock Infinite! There are even more hidden gems and fan favorites to explore in this bundle, so grab it now at the price of your choosing and support Covenant House with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before February 7th, 2027.

item.title: Squad Goals
item.content:encoded:
Grab a friend or two and cozy up with the Squad Goals Bundle, an epic collection of co-op titles perfect for staying connected with your bestie this summer. Use your Turtle Power to rescue Master Splinter from the evil Foot Clan in Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate, a rad roguelike with endless replayability that comes packed with the Metalhead DLC! Or race against the clock to get dishes out hot in PlateUp!, a fast-paced restaurant management sim! Pay what you want for eight amazing co-op games and help support Child's Play when you shop with Humble!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before January 31st, 2027.
